name: Acceptance voice mode
description: The acceptance run's third-party voice mode: chosen in Settings › Voice it says each reply at once through the bot's own voice provider (the run's tone voice) and plays offered sound; not chosen it can neither sound nor hear. Its commands: `chime` plays a short tone as Alpha's voice (the `audio` capability), `sink` tries the player itself, `report` says what it has said.

commands.name: chime
commands.description: Plays a short tone as Alpha's voice.

commands.name: sink
commands.description: Sends the player a piece itself: refused unless this is the active voice.

commands.name: report
commands.description: What this voice mode has said and played.
